statement_notes.note: Net margin -168.84% and the 6.09pp fall are correct. The loss shrank while revenue fell, so the margin worsened.
Bad Debts moved from 12,935.29 to -1,806.24, which is a negative or reversing line. It is named correctly.
No entry in one_offs has month 2026-06. The only 2026 item is SKU Profiling in 2026-04.

open_questions.question: What explains the Bad Debts credit of -1,806.24 in June, against 12,935.29 in May? Is it a recovery or reversal of a prior provision?
open_questions.why: It is the second-largest movement and cuts operating expenses by 14.7k. If it is non-recurring, underlying operating expenses are higher than reported.

open_questions.question: What is the nature of the Events & Conferences increase, from 11,323.91 to 29,294.58? Is it one-off or recurring?
open_questions.why: It is the largest movement and, at 6.3% of operating expenses, the main offset to the other cost reductions.

open_questions.question: Why did Partnership Income and Professional Services fall to zero, and why did Usage Fees fall 6.3%?
open_questions.why: These three lines account for the whole 12.5k revenue decline (-476.73, -833.33 and -11,142.74). Whether they continue matters for runway.

open_questions.question: Is the drop in Partnerships Commission (10,800 to 1,800) and Sales Commission (13,126.41 to 5,926.88) a timing difference?
open_questions.why: These lines drive much of the cost reduction and may reverse next month.
